behavioral_effects: The weekly frontend-js group is limited to minor and patch update-types, and semver-major updates for the bun ecosystem are ignored entirely with the rationale recorded in the config comment
compatibility_impact: None for the application. Dependabot's next frontend-js PR will contain only minor and patch bumps; the currently pending majors (Next 16, next-intl 4, TypeScript 7, ESLint 10, vitest 4, lucide-react 1.x, and peers) stop being proposed automatically and await deliberate migration sessions.
follow_up: Run the frontend majors migration as its own governed session: Next 15 to 16, next-intl 3 to 4, TypeScript and typescript-eslint when TS 7 is supported, ESLint 10, vitest 4, and replace the removed lucide-react brand icons (Github, Linkedin, Twitter) with simple-icons or @lucide/lab equivalents
limitations: Shrink pass: nine-line config addition whose comment carries the policy rationale; nothing to remove
The pending majors now have no automated reminder; the Next 16 / TypeScript / ESLint toolchain migration (including replacing lucide-react brand icons) must be scheduled deliberately
reason: The weekly frontend-js group bundled every pending major (Next 16, TypeScript 7, ESLint 10, lucide-react 1.x) into one PR that fails three independent ways and can never merge - majors need deliberate migration sessions, so the automated group must stop proposing them
rollback: git revert restores the previous config; Dependabot resumes proposing grouped majors on its next weekly run. Already-closed PR 32 stays closed either way.
security_impact: None, deliberately: narrows what automation proposes; no code or dependency actually changes.
summary: Limit the frontend-js Dependabot group to minor and patch updates so grouped PRs stay mergeable
